moisture_pct.quote: There are 41.1g of water by weight in 100 grams of Cheese, Lancashire

fat_pct.quote: Cheese, Lancashire has 24.1 grams of protein, and 31.7 grams of fat per 100g.

salt_pct.quote: Salt, 1.44 g, Sodium, 575 mg, Potassium, 81 mg, Calcium, 572 mg, Magnesium, 22 mg, Phosphorus, 422 mg, Iron, 0.3 mg, Copper, 0.03 mg, Zinc, 3.6 mg, Chloride,

ammonia.reason: Young low-proteolysis interior without surface deamination gives minimal NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized milk and no smear flora limits p-cresol/indole/skatole.

bitter.reason: Few hydrophobic bitter peptides; short age and 1.44% salt suppress bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, no C7/C9 methyl ketones from beta-oxidation.

browning.reason: Moderate moisture/protein Maillard with residual lactose browns modestly when grilled.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate to diacetyl/acetoin in young curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Limited lipase release of butanoic/hexanoic acids in 2-month rennet curd.

creaminess.reason: 31.7% fat and young hydrated protein matrix gives smooth creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Low-pH calcium-phosphate loss plus blended 2-3 day curds fracture easily.

firmness.reason: Pressed 41.1% moisture semi-hard body demineralized at low pH firms curd.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylalanine to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol in short age.

fruity.reason: Low esterase formation of ethyl butanoate/hexanoate in young cheese.

malty_nutty.reason: Low Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal from limited leucine/isoleucine catabolism.

melt.reason: Young hydrated rennet gel with intact casein flows moderately on heating.

oil_off.reason: Moderate 31.7% fat free-oil release on melting, no exudation when cold.

sour_vinegar.reason: Multi-day acidified curd retains lactic acid plus Lactococcus acetate at pH ~4.9.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata crumbly network lacks aligned flowable casein for stretch.

sulfur_cooked.reason: No curd cooking and low Lactococcus methionine to methional/methanethiol.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/galactose and glycerol balance lactic sourness.

umami.reason: Early chymosin/plasmin proteolysis releases modest glutamate peptides.
